name: Diffbot MCP
tagline: The Knowledge Graph — structured data from any public web page.
shortDescription: The Diffbot MCP server. Extract structured entities (products, articles, people, companies, discussions) from any URL. Trained on the public web, returns typed JSON.
longDescription:
## What it is

Diffbot's MCP server. Connects your agent to the Diffbot Knowledge Graph: extract structured data from any URL using Diffbot's trained extractors, query the global Knowledge Graph for entities, and resolve ambiguities.

## Why we recommend it

Diffbot has been crawling the public web since 2010 and has one of the most complete structured knowledge graphs. The MCP server gives your agent access to a vast database of products, articles, companies, and people — all queryable by URL or natural language.

## When to use it

- Product data: agent extracts full product details from a URL
- People/companies: agent resolves a name to canonical entity + facts
- News: agent finds all articles about a topic from the past year
- Competitive intel: agent builds a structured picture of a competitor's web footprint
installInstructions:
1. Sign up at https://www.diffbot.com and get an API token
2. Set `DIFFBOT_TOKEN=...`
3. `npx -y @diffbot/mcp`

**Free tier:** 10K API calls/month, no card required.
pricingDetails: Free tier: 10K calls/month. Developer: $299/month for 250K calls. Enterprise: custom.
